entities.summary: Bilibili, nicknamed B Site, is a Chinese online video sharing website based in Shanghai where users can submit, view, and add overlaid commentary on videos. Bilibili is a website in East Asia, established around 2009-06-26. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
